summary: [Slack] webhooks: Events API: each request signed (X-Slack-Signature = HMAC-SHA256 of v0=<timestamp>:<body> with signing secret; check timestamp freshness). URL verification challenge on setup (echo challenge). Retries flagged X-Slack-Retry-Num/Reason: dedupe by event_id. Socket Mode replaces webhooks with the token-auth websocket. Ack within 3 seconds; slow work async.
